quote: Automatic approaches for retrieving and assigning images from the web to textbook chapters can therefore assist textbook designers in the creation of better textbooks.

Annotators answer a set of predefined questions about each image, covering relevance, redundancy, type, and didactic usefulness at both the local (subsection) and global (section) level.

The annotators first answer the local questions for all images and then the global questions. This way we made sure that they scanned the entire section and had a some overview of all images and how they relate to each other before answering the global questions.
